Nigeria’s Flamingos are all set to take on Japan in the final of the 2026 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup tonight at the Mohammed VI Football Complex in Rabat, Morocco.
The Coach Akeem Busari-led Falmingos team are seeking to win the country’s and indeed the continet’s first-ever title in the competition.
The Nigerian side made history by reaching the final after a remarkable 3-1 victory over Brazil in the semi-finals , guaranteeing at least a silver medal and surpassing their previous best finish of third place in 2022.
Japan, meanwhile, stand between the Flamingos and a historic triumph as both teams pursue their maiden title.
Follow PREMIUM TIMES for live updates, goals and key moments as Nigeria chase their first U-17 Women’s World Cup crown.
